info.title: Legal Lens API
info.description: Backend for Legal Lens (milestone M3). Contract mirrors frontend/src/api/types.ts.

post.description:
Signs in and sets the session cookie. Do this first: Swagger then sends the cookie with every
other call.

Creates an empty conversation. **There is nothing to fill in**: click *Try it out*, then
*Execute*. The backend assigns the id, title ("New conversation") and timestamps.

Copy the `id` from the response and use it with **POST /api/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages**
to ask the first question. (Sign in with POST /api/auth/login first, or this returns 401.)

post.summary: Send a message (ask, summarize or draft) — streamed
post.description:
One chat turn, streamed over server-sent events (FR-10).

Paste the `id` returned by **POST /api/conversations** into `conversation_id`, pick an example from
the *Examples* dropdown (or write your own), then *Execute*. Swagger shows the whole stream once it
has finished: `meta`, `stage`s, `excerpt`s, `citation`s, `token`s, `usage`, then `done`.
The example document ids exist when the demo data is loaded (`scripts/seed_demo`).
